```{r}
require(tidyverse)
require(lme4)
require(marginaleffects)

std_analysis = function(df, outcome, ...){
  regions = distinct(df, country, region)
  
  frm_outlets = paste(outcome, "~ 1 + (1|country) + (1|outlet)")
  m_outlets = glmer(frm_outlets, data = df, ...) 
  
  frm_platforms = paste(outcome, "~ platform + (platform|country)")
  m_platforms = glmer(frm_platforms, data = df, ...) 
  
  avg = avg_predictions(m_platforms, re.form = NA)
  
  outlet_preds = m_outlets |> 
    avg_predictions(by = "outlet", re.form = NULL)  |> 
    as_tibble() |> 
    left_join(regions)
  
  country_preds = m_platforms |> 
    avg_predictions(by = "country", re.form = NULL) |> 
    as_tibble() |> 
    left_join(regions)
  
  country_plot = outlet_preds |> 
    left_join(country_preds |> select(country, region, avg = estimate)) |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(country, avg),  y = estimate, color = region))+
    geom_point(alpha = .33, size = 1)+
    geom_pointrange(data =country_preds, aes(x = country, y = estimate, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, color = region))+
    labs(y = outcome)+
    coord_flip()
  
  platform_preds = m_platforms |> 
    avg_predictions(by = "platform") |> 
    as_tibble()
  
  platform_plot =
    platform_preds |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = fct_rev(platform), y = estimate, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high))+
    geom_pointrange()+
    labs(y = outcome)+
    coord_flip()
  
  lst(avg, outlet_preds, country_preds, platform_preds, platform_plot, country_plot, platform_plot)
}
```
